g.title: HELLA_PEDAL
g.text: Universal floor-mount -- fabricate bracket, no OEM pedal box needed

6-pin dual-track hall-effect sensor (same dual-redundancy principle as E46 pedal). MaxxECU has a native pre-defined Hella profile -- select it in MTune before running the pedal calibration wizard. Universal floor-mount module -- mount position fabricated from aluminum plate. Used in Porsche 944/914 swaps and kit cars for exactly this reason. Source: Hella OEM supply or from a donor application. ~$80-120 new. Pinout source: MaxxECU E-Pedals Wiring Docs (maxxecu.se/webhelp/wirings-e_pedals.html). Note: Hella pin order differs from E46 pedal — signal wires are 6/3, not 4/6.

g.title: CABLE_PEDAL_TO_MAXXECU
g.text: MAXXECU_SUPPLY:2:CMC H1 (Sensor GND) — shared sensor ground bus
MAXXECU_SUPPLY:1:CMC G1 (+5V sensor supply) — shared with TPS/MAP/CLT/CAM
MAXXECU_SUPPLY:2:CMC H1 (Sensor GND) — shared sensor ground bus
MAXXECU_SUPPLY:1:CMC G1 (+5V sensor supply) — shared with TPS/MAP/CLT/CAM

Cabin footwell → Maven HD30 Connector B (cabin face, at firewall) — 6 wires crossing to engine-bay MaxxECU via Connector B pins 1-6 under the H2O arch. Cabin-side run only in this cable file — the engine-side hop is documented in harnesses/firewall-crossing-maven.wv. Route the cabin portion along tunnel/sill, away from audio wiring. 24 AWG sufficient -- low-current sensor signals only. Shielded 6-conductor; drain shield at MaxxECU end only (single-end drain). Tie drain wire to CMC H1 (Sensor GND). Wire 1 BN: GND1 (pedal pin 1) → MAXXECU_SUPPLY GND bus (CMC H1). Wire 2 RD: +5V2 (pedal pin 2) → MAXXECU_SUPPLY +5V rail (CMC G1). Wire 3 WH: TPS2/APS2 signal (pedal pin 3) → MAXXECU_C2 F1 (AIN 7). Wire 4 BN: GND2 (pedal pin 4) → MAXXECU_SUPPLY GND bus (CMC H1). Wire 5 RD: +5V1 (pedal pin 5) → MAXXECU_SUPPLY +5V rail (CMC G1). Wire 6 WH: TPS1/APS1 signal (pedal pin 6) → MAXXECU_C2 E4 (AIN 6). Note: wire-color order differs from E46 variant -- label both ends clearly. APS crosses firewall via Maven Connector B (see harnesses/firewall-crossing-maven.wv).

g.title: MAXXECU_C2
g.text: MaxxECU RACE GEN1 C2 connector (32-pin Molex CMC)
Cabin-mounted ECU -- APS signal inputs at C2 E4 (AIN 6) and C2 F1 (AIN 7)
Confirmed from MaxxECU RACE GEN1 C2 pinout:

Source: maxxecu.com/webhelp/wirings-maxxecu_pinout.html AIN 5 (C2 G3) is occupied by the virtual clutch position sensor. MTune path: Settings → E-Throttle → Pedal position → load Hella 6PV010946-141 native profile, then assign AIN 6 (APS1) and AIN 7 (APS2).

g.title: MAXXECU_SUPPLY
g.text: MaxxECU RACE main CMC supply rails
+5V sensor supply (CMC G1) and Sensor GND (CMC H1) -- shared bus
CMC G1 (+5V sensor supply) — shared with TPS/MAP/CLT/CAM
CMC H1 (Sensor GND) — shared sensor ground bus

Both APS circuits tap the same MaxxECU +5V sensor supply rail (CMC G1). Both APS sensor grounds return to the sensor GND bus (CMC H1). Do NOT connect APS GND to chassis GND or engine GND (C2 G4). Must go to sensor GND bus. Same supply points as E46 variant (epedal-bmw-e46.wv).
